messages.author: e4231721a931f6e2
messages.subject: adding statcounter into a shiny app
parts:
Hello,

How would I go about adding statcounter into a shiny app? I tried putting the Default javascript into a file called statcounter.js in my shinyapp folder then calling it with includeHTML("statcounter.js") in my mainPanel. That worked locally, but not on the web. I tried poking around with adding a 'www' folder putting statcounter.js into 'www/js/' then using tag$script(src="js/statcounter.js") but that had no effect at all (locally or online). I'm pretty new to javascript, but I'm eager to learn. Any help that could be provided would be much appreciated.

Thanks,
Steve
